learn.h:
🌡️ Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

The six phase changes六种相变

Frost appears on a car window overnight without ever being liquid water — which of the six phase changes is that?一夜之间，车窗上结了霜，中间从来没有变成过液态水——这是六种相变中的哪一种？

Difficulty难度 ●○○
⏱ 20 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · The six phase changes六种相变
  1. s→l melting · l→s freezing · l→g evaporation · g→l condensation固→液 熔化 · 液→固 凝固 · 液→气 汽化 · 气→液 液化
  2. s→g sublimation · g→s deposition (both skip the liquid)固→气 升华 · 气→固 凝华（都跳过液态）
  3. All are physical changes. Toward gas absorbs energy; away from gas releases it.都是物理变化。朝气态吸收能量；离开气态放出能量。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · The six phase changes六种相变

Particles in the three states三种状态中的粒子

🧗 The hard part难点 · The six phase changes六种相变

Sublimation vs deposition升华与凝华

Both skip the liquid, so students swap them.两者都跳过液态，学生常常搞反。

  1. Find the START state.找出起始状态。
  2. Starts solid → sublimation. Starts gas → deposition.从固体开始 → 升华；从气体开始 → 凝华。
Try试一试
How many of the six phase changes skip the liquid state?六种相变中有几种跳过液态？
Answer答案
2 (sublimation and deposition).2 种（升华和凝华）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · The six phase changes六种相变
  • Frost = freezing ✗ → frost = deposition (vapour → ice) ✓霜＝凝固 ✗ → 霜＝凝华（水蒸气 → 冰）✓
🟡
Your class diagram names liquid → gas "evaporation". Many textbooks call it "vaporization" and split it into evaporation (at the surface, below the boiling point) and boiling (throughout the liquid, at the boiling point). On this test, "evaporation" is the expected name; on the heating curve, the flat step at 100 °C is called "boiling".课堂笔记的三角图把「液 → 气」叫做「汽化（evaporation）」。很多教科书称之为 vaporization，并细分为表面汽化（低于沸点）和沸腾（整个液体内部、在沸点）。本次考试答「evaporation 汽化」即可；加热曲线上 100 °C 的平台则叫「沸腾」。
🎯
Write "start → end" in states first; the name follows from the triangle.先写「起始状态 → 最终状态」，名字从三角图上读出来。

🌡️ Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

Heating curve of water水的加热曲线

The burner under a pot of ice water is on full, yet the thermometer is stuck at 0 °C for minutes — where is all that heat going?一锅冰水下面的火开到最大，温度计却好几分钟都停在 0 °C——那么多热量跑到哪里去了？

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Heating curve of water水的加热曲线
  1. Diagonal = temperature changing (one phase). Horizontal = phase changing (two phases), T constant.斜线＝温度变（一个相）。水平线＝相变（两个相），温度不变。
  2. Water: 1 ice warms · 2 melts at 0 °C · 3 liquid warms · 4 boils at 100 °C · 5 steam warms.水：1 冰升温 · 2 0 °C 熔化 · 3 液体升温 · 4 100 °C 沸腾 · 5 水蒸气升温。
  3. Flat because energy breaks attractions or separates particles, not speeding them up.平台是因为能量用来打破吸引或分开粒子，而不是让粒子加速。
diagonal⇒temperature changes;horizontal⇒phase changes

🧗 The hard part难点 · Heating curve of water水的加热曲线

Why the temperature stops rising为什么温度不再上升

It feels wrong that adding heat does not raise the temperature.「加热却不升温」违反直觉。

  1. Temperature tracks how fast particles move.温度反映粒子运动的快慢。
  2. On a flat part, energy goes into pulling particles apart.水平段上，能量用来把粒子拉开。
  3. Speed unchanged → temperature unchanged until the phase change is complete.速度不变 → 温度不变，直到相变完成。
Try试一试
Ice at −20 °C is heated to 120 °C. How many flat segments?−20 °C 的冰加热到 120 °C，有几个水平段？
Answer答案
2 (melting at 0 °C, boiling at 100 °C).2 个（0 °C 熔化，100 °C 沸腾）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Heating curve of water水的加热曲线
  • Heat added → temperature must rise ✗ → not on the flat parts ✓加热 → 温度一定升 ✗ → 水平段上不升 ✓
  • Flat part = one phase ✗ → two phases together ✓水平段＝一个相 ✗ → 两个相共存 ✓
🟡
Your class notes put "heat added" on the x-axis. Many textbooks put "time" there instead (with heat added at a steady rate) — the shape and the five segments are exactly the same, so read either graph the same way.课堂笔记的横轴是「加入的热量」。很多教科书横轴写的是「时间」（假设匀速加热）——曲线形状和五段完全一样，两种图读法相同。
🎯
Cooling curve = read right to left: condense at 100 °C, freeze at 0 °C.冷却曲线＝从右往左读：100 °C 液化，0 °C 凝固。

🌡️ Phase Changes & Energy相变与能量

Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动

A water molecule can spin like a top, shake like a spring, or fly across the room — only one of these lets ice melt and water boil.一个水分子可以像陀螺一样转、像弹簧一样抖，也可以飞过整个房间——只有其中一种能让冰熔化、让水沸腾。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动
  1. Kinetic energy = energy of motion; temperature up → faster → more kinetic energy.动能＝运动的能量；温度升 → 更快 → 动能更大。
  2. Rotational spins (bonds same) · vibrational stretches/bends in place · translational moves place to place.转动：旋转（键不变）· 振动：原地伸缩弯曲 · 平动：从一处移到另一处。
  3. Translational energy matters most for phase changes: particles must pull away from each other.平动能对相变最重要：粒子必须彼此拉开。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动
  • Kinetic energy of molecules分子的动能
    • Rotational转动spins; bond lengths & angles unchanged转动；键长、键角不变
    • Vibrational振动stretches & bends; bonds change; stays in place伸缩、弯曲；键改变；位置不变
    • Translational平动moves place to place; bonds unchanged — key for phase change从一处移到另一处；键不变——相变的关键

🧗 The hard part难点 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动

Rotational vs vibrational转动与振动

Both happen in place, so students mix them up.两者都在原地发生，学生容易搞混。

  1. Both: molecule stays in the same place.共同点：分子位置不变。
  2. Bonds unchanged → rotational (spinning).键不变 → 转动。
  3. Bonds stretch or bend → vibrational.键伸缩或弯曲 → 振动。
Try试一试
How many of the three motion types keep bond lengths and angles the same?三种运动中，有几种键长和键角保持不变？
Answer答案
2 (rotational and translational).2 种（转动和平动）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Kinetic energy: rotational, vibrational, translational动能：转动、振动、平动
  • Vibrating molecule moves across the box ✗ → vibration is in place; moving across is translational ✓振动的分子会穿过盒子 ✗ → 振动在原地；穿过盒子是平动 ✓
🟡
Your class graph says a solid gains "vibrational and translational" energy as it warms, while the table says solid particles "mostly vibrate in place". Many textbooks say solid particles only vibrate. On this test: solid = mostly vibrating in place; if asked what increases while a solid warms, give the class answer (vibrational, plus some translational).课堂图上说固体升温时获得「振动和平动」能量，而表格写的是固体粒子「主要在原地振动」。很多教科书说固体粒子只振动。本次考试：固体＝主要在原地振动；若问固体升温时增加的是什么，按课堂答案写（振动，加上少量平动）。
🎯
Two-question test: bonds change? position change? — that names the motion.两问法：键变吗？位置变吗？——就能说出运动类型。

quiz.q: A solid turning directly into a gas is called ______.固体直接变成气体叫做______。
quiz.a: sublimation升华
quiz.sol: • Solid → gas = sublimation.固 → 气＝升华。
quiz.goal: Recall the name for solid → gas.记住固 → 气的名称。
quiz.idea: It skips the liquid state.跳过了液态。

quiz.q: Gas turning into liquid is called ______.气体变成液体叫做______。
quiz.a: condensation液化（凝结）
quiz.sol: • Gas → liquid = condensation.气 → 液＝液化（凝结）。
quiz.goal: Recall the name for gas → liquid.记住气 → 液的名称。
quiz.idea: Steam on a cold mirror.冷镜子上的水汽。

quiz.q: Name the change: HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(s)说出变化名称：HX2​O(l)​HX2​O(s)
quiz.a: freezing凝固
quiz.sol: • Liquid → solid = freezing.液 → 固＝凝固。
quiz.goal: Name a phase change from state symbols.根据状态符号说出相变名称。
quiz.idea: (l) → (s) is liquid → solid.(l) → (s) 就是液 → 固。

quiz.q: Frost forms on grass on a clear, cold night without dew forming first. This is:晴朗寒冷的夜晚，草上直接结霜，之前没有先结露。这是：
c: freezing凝固
condensation液化（凝结）
sublimation升华
deposition凝华
quiz.a: deposition凝华
quiz.sol: • Water vapour (gas) → ice (solid) with no liquid in between → deposition.水蒸气（气）→ 冰（固），中间没有液态 → 凝华。
quiz.goal: Spot gas → solid in a real situation.在真实情境中识别气 → 固。
quiz.idea: "Without dew first" means no liquid step.「没有先结露」说明没有液态这一步。

quiz.q: Mothballs in a closet slowly get smaller over months, but there is never any liquid. Which phase change is happening?衣柜里的樟脑丸几个月里慢慢变小，但从来没有出现过液体。发生的是哪种相变？
quiz.a: sublimation升华
quiz.sol: • The solid becomes gas directly (you can smell it) with no liquid → sublimation.固体直接变成气体（能闻到气味），没有液体 → 升华。
quiz.goal: Infer sublimation from evidence in an unfamiliar case.从陌生情境的证据推断出升华。
quiz.idea: Getting smaller = particles leaving; no liquid = they leave as gas directly.变小＝粒子离开；没有液体＝直接以气体离开。

quiz.q: Which group lists the three phase changes in which the substance ABSORBS energy?哪一组列出的三种相变都需要「吸收」能量？
c: melting, evaporation, sublimation熔化、汽化、升华
freezing, condensation, deposition凝固、液化、凝华
melting, freezing, condensation熔化、凝固、液化
sublimation, deposition, evaporation升华、凝华、汽化
quiz.a: melting, evaporation, sublimation熔化、汽化、升华
quiz.sol: • Melting, evaporation, sublimation all move toward a more spread-out state, so energy must be absorbed to separate the particles.熔化、汽化、升华都朝更松散的状态变化，需要吸收能量来分开粒子。
quiz.goal: Connect phase-change direction with energy.把相变方向和能量联系起来。
quiz.idea: Toward gas = particles pulled apart = energy in.朝气态＝粒子被拉开＝吸收能量。

quiz.q: A cold can of pop is taken out of the fridge. Within minutes, drops of water cover the outside of the can. (a) Where does the water come from? (b) Name the phase change. (c) Is it physical or chemical? Justify.从冰箱拿出一罐冷饮，几分钟内罐子外面布满水珠。(a) 水从哪来？(b) 说出相变名称。(c) 是物理变化还是化学变化？说明理由。
quiz.a: (a) Water vapour in the air. (b) Condensation. (c) Physical — it is still HX2​O, only the phase changed.(a) 空气中的水蒸气。(b) 液化（凝结）。(c) 物理变化——仍是 HX2​O，只是相变了。
quiz.sol:
• Air contains water vapour. When it touches the cold can, it cools and turns into liquid drops.空气中含有水蒸气，碰到冰冷的罐子后冷却，变成液态水珠。
  • Gas → liquid = condensation. HX2​O(g)​HX2​O(l): same substance → physical change.气 → 液＝液化（凝结）。HX2​O(g)​HX2​O(l)：同种物质 → 物理变化。
quiz.goal: Explain a real event with a phase change and classify the change.用相变解释一个真实现象，并判断变化类型。
quiz.idea: The can is sealed, so the water cannot come from inside; it comes from water vapour in the air.罐子是密封的，水不可能来自罐内；它来自空气中的水蒸气。

quiz.q: On a heating curve, a horizontal line means the ______ is changing while the temperature stays constant.加热曲线上，水平线表示______在变化，而温度不变。
quiz.a: phase (state)相（状态）
quiz.sol: • Horizontal = phase change, temperature constant.水平线＝相变，温度不变。
quiz.goal: Recall the horizontal-line rule.记住水平线规则。
quiz.idea: Flat = phase change.水平＝相变。

quiz.q: At what temperature (°C) is the boiling segment (segment 4) for water?水的沸腾段（第 4 段）在多少摄氏度？
quiz.a: 100 °C
quiz.sol: • Segment 4 is boiling, at 100 °C for water.第 4 段是沸腾，水为 100 °C。
quiz.goal: Recall the boiling point of water on the curve.记住曲线上水的沸点。
quiz.idea: The second flat part.第二个水平段。

quiz.q: In which segment are both solid and liquid present?哪一段同时存在固体和液体？
quiz.a: Segment 2 (melting, 0 °C)第 2 段（熔化，0 °C）
quiz.sol: • Segment 2 is melting: ice and liquid water together at 0 °C.第 2 段是熔化：0 °C 时冰和水共存。
quiz.goal: Link the melting plateau to two phases.把熔化平台与两相共存联系起来。
quiz.idea: Two phases only on a flat part — the melting one.只有水平段两相共存——熔化的那一段。

quiz.q: In segment 3, is the temperature changing? If so, rising or falling?第 3 段温度在变吗？如果在变，是升还是降？
quiz.a: Yes — rising from 0 °C to 100 °C (liquid water warming).在变——从 0 °C 升到 100 °C（液态水升温）。
quiz.sol: • Segment 3 is diagonal: liquid water warms from 0 °C to 100 °C, particles move faster.第 3 段是斜线：液态水从 0 °C 升到 100 °C，粒子运动加快。
quiz.goal: Read a diagonal segment.读懂一段斜线。
quiz.idea: Diagonal going up = temperature rising.向上的斜线＝温度上升。

quiz.q: A sample of water is at 100 °C and both liquid and gas are present. Which segment number is it in?一份水处于 100 °C，液体和气体同时存在。它在第几段？
quiz.a: 4第 4 段
quiz.sol: • Boiling is segment 4.沸腾是第 4 段。
quiz.goal: Locate a state on the curve from temperature and phases.根据温度和相在曲线上定位。
quiz.idea: Liquid + gas at 100 °C = boiling plateau.100 °C 液＋气＝沸腾平台。

quiz.q: Why does the temperature stay constant while water boils, even though the burner is still on?为什么水沸腾时，即使火一直开着，温度也保持不变？
c: The burner stops giving heat at 100 °C.到 100 °C 时，炉子就不再供热了。
The heat makes the particles move faster, but the thermometer cannot read above 100 °C.热量让粒子跑得更快，只是温度计读不到 100 °C 以上。
The water molecules are breaking into hydrogen and oxygen.水分子正在分解成氢和氧。
The heat is used to separate particles into the gas phase, not to make them move faster.热量用来把粒子分开、变成气体，而不是让它们跑得更快。
quiz.a: The heat separates particles into the gas phase instead of speeding them up.热量用于把粒子分开成气体，而不是让它们加速。
quiz.sol: • During boiling, energy is used to pull particles away from their neighbours into the gas phase, not to increase their average speed, so the temperature stays at 100 °C.沸腾时，能量用来把粒子从邻近粒子中拉出、进入气相，而不是提高平均速度，所以温度保持在 100 °C。
quiz.goal: Explain a plateau using where the energy goes.用能量去向解释平台。
quiz.idea: Energy goes into separating particles; average speed (temperature) is unchanged.能量用于分开粒子；平均速度（温度）不变。

quiz.q: Which kind of kinetic energy matters most for a phase change (rotational, vibrational or translational)?对相变最重要的是哪种动能（转动、振动还是平动）？
quiz.a: translational平动动能
quiz.sol: • Only translational motion moves a particle from place to place, letting it break away from its neighbours.只有平动能让粒子从一处移到另一处，从而挣脱周围粒子。
quiz.goal: Connect the heating curve to the type of particle motion.把加热曲线和粒子运动的类型联系起来。
quiz.idea: To change phase, particles must move away from each other — moving from place to place.要发生相变，粒子必须彼此远离——也就是从一处移到另一处。

quiz.q: A student heats crushed ice from −15 °C at a steady rate and records: 0–2 min temperature rises to 0 °C; 2–8 min it stays at 0 °C; 8–16 min it rises to 100 °C. At minute 5: (a) what temperature does the thermometer show (°C)? (b) what is in the beaker? (c) what is the heat doing?某学生匀速加热 −15 °C 的碎冰，记录：0–2 分钟升到 0 °C；2–8 分钟保持 0 °C；8–16 分钟升到 100 °C。第 5 分钟时：(a) 温度计读数多少（°C）？(b) 烧杯里有什么？(c) 热量在做什么？
quiz.a: (a) 0 °C. (b) A mixture of ice and liquid water. (c) Breaking the attractions holding the ice particles together (melting), not raising the temperature.(a) 0 °C。(b) 冰和液态水的混合。(c) 打破冰中粒子之间的吸引（熔化），而不是升温。
quiz.sol:
• Minute 5 is in the 2–8 min flat part at 0 °C → segment 2, melting.第 5 分钟在 2–8 分钟、0 °C 的水平段 → 第 2 段，熔化。
  • Both solid ice and liquid water are present; the heat is breaking attractions so particles can slide past each other, so the temperature stays at 0 °C.固态冰和液态水同时存在；热量用来打破吸引力，让粒子能彼此滑动，所以温度保持 0 °C。
quiz.goal: Interpret real lab data as a heating curve.把真实实验数据解读成加热曲线。
quiz.idea: Minute 5 falls inside the 2–8 min plateau, i.e. segment 2.第 5 分钟落在 2–8 分钟的平台内，也就是第 2 段。

quiz.q: Kinetic energy is the energy particles have because they are ______.动能是粒子因为______而具有的能量。
quiz.a: moving运动
quiz.sol: • Kinetic energy = energy of motion.动能＝运动的能量。
quiz.goal: Recall the definition of kinetic energy.记住动能的定义。
quiz.idea: Kinetic = motion.动能＝运动的能量。

quiz.q: In which type of motion do bond lengths and bond angles change while the molecule stays in the same place?哪种运动中键长和键角改变，而分子留在原处？
c: rotational转动
vibrational振动
translational平动
none of these都不是
quiz.a: vibrational振动
quiz.sol: • Only vibrational motion changes bond lengths and angles, and it happens in place.只有振动会改变键长和键角，而且是原地发生的。
quiz.goal: Recall the features of vibrational motion.记住振动的特征。
quiz.idea: Bonds changing = shaking = vibrational.键改变＝抖动＝振动。

quiz.q: A nitrogen molecule travels from one side of a balloon to the other. Which type of motion is this?一个氮分子从气球的一边运动到另一边。这是哪种运动？
quiz.a: translational平动
quiz.sol: • Moving from place to place → translational.从一处移到另一处 → 平动。
quiz.goal: Classify a change of position.判断位置改变属于哪种运动。
quiz.idea: The whole molecule changes place.整个分子换了位置。

quiz.q: A water molecule turns around its centre without its bonds changing. Which type of motion?一个水分子绕自身中心转动，键不变。这是哪种运动？
quiz.a: rotational转动
quiz.sol: • Spinning, bonds unchanged, stays in place → rotational.旋转、键不变、位置不变 → 转动。
quiz.goal: Classify spinning.判断旋转属于哪种运动。
quiz.idea: Spinning in place with bonds fixed.原地旋转，键不变。

quiz.q: When the temperature of a gas increases, what happens to its particles?气体温度升高时，它的粒子会怎样？
c: They move slower and lose kinetic energy.运动变慢，动能减少。
They get bigger.粒子自己变大。
They move faster and gain kinetic energy.运动更快，动能增加。
They stop moving and spread out.停止运动并散开。
quiz.a: They move faster and gain kinetic energy.运动更快，动能增加。
quiz.sol: • Higher temperature means faster particles, so kinetic energy increases. Particles do not change size.温度越高粒子越快，动能越大。粒子本身大小不变。
quiz.goal: Apply the temperature–kinetic energy link.运用温度与动能的关系。
quiz.idea: Temperature up → faster → more kinetic energy.温度升 → 更快 → 动能增大。

quiz.q: In a solid, the particles are packed close together and mostly ______ in place.固体中粒子紧密排列，主要在原地______。
quiz.a: vibrate振动
quiz.sol: • Locked in position, solid particles mostly vibrate; adding energy makes them vibrate harder.固体粒子位置固定，主要在振动；加能量后振动得更剧烈。
quiz.goal: Connect the states of matter with the type of motion.把物质状态和运动类型联系起来。
quiz.idea: Solids cannot move around (Topic 2), so they shake in place.固体粒子不能到处移动（第 2 课），所以在原地抖动。

quiz.q: Explain why translational energy is the type that matters most for a phase change.解释为什么对相变最重要的是平动能。
quiz.a: To change phase, particles must move away from their neighbours. Only translational motion moves a particle from place to place; spinning and vibrating happen in place.要相变，粒子必须离开周围的粒子。只有平动让粒子从一处移到另一处；旋转和振动都在原地发生。
quiz.sol:
• Particles need enough freedom to pull away from each other.粒子需要足够的自由才能彼此拉开。
  • Only translational motion carries them away; when it reaches a critical value, they break out of the solid or liquid.只有平动能带着它们离开；平动能达到临界值时，它们就挣脱固体或液体。
quiz.goal: Justify the key role of translational energy.说明平动能的关键作用。
quiz.idea: A phase change needs particles to pull away from each other.相变需要粒子彼此拉开。

quiz.q: Water at 100 °C is boiling on a stove. A student says: "The burner is adding energy, so the kinetic energy of the water molecules must be going up." Is the student right? Explain using kinetic energy and the heating curve.炉子上 100 °C 的水正在沸腾。某学生说：「炉子在加能量，所以水分子的动能一定在增加。」他说得对吗？用动能和加热曲线解释。
quiz.a: No. The temperature stays at 100 °C, so the average kinetic energy (speed) of the molecules is not increasing. The added energy separates particles so they escape into the gas phase.不对。温度保持 100 °C，所以分子的平均动能（速度）没有增加。加入的能量用来分开粒子，让它们逃入气相。
quiz.sol:
• During boiling the curve is horizontal: temperature is constant at 100 °C.沸腾时曲线是水平的：温度恒定在 100 °C。
  • Constant temperature means the particles are not moving faster on average, so average kinetic energy is not rising.温度不变说明粒子平均速度没有加快，平均动能没有增加。
  • The energy is used to separate particles from the liquid into the gas.能量用来把粒子从液体中分开、变成气体。
quiz.goal: Combine kinetic energy and the boiling plateau to judge a claim.结合动能和沸腾平台判断一个说法。
quiz.idea: Temperature constant = average kinetic energy constant; the energy goes into separating particles.温度不变＝平均动能不变；能量用来分开粒子。

diag.q: Gas turning directly into a solid is called:气体直接变成固体叫做：
c: sublimation升华
condensation液化（凝结）
deposition凝华
freezing凝固
why: Reversed the direction: sublimation is solid → gas.方向搞反了：升华是固 → 气。
Condensation ends as a liquid, not a solid.液化的终点是液体，不是固体。
Correct: gas → solid = deposition.正确：气 → 固＝凝华。
Freezing starts from a liquid, not a gas.凝固从液体开始，不是气体。
diag.goal: Match the gas → solid arrow to its name.把气 → 固的箭头和名称对上。
diag.idea: Check both the start and the end state.起点和终点都要核对。

diag.q: A block of dry ice (COX2​(s)) gives off white fog and shrinks, but never leaves a puddle. Which description is correct?一块干冰（COX2​(s)）冒出白雾并不断变小，但从不留下液体。哪个描述正确？
c: Sublimation; a physical change升华；物理变化
Melting; a physical change熔化；物理变化
Sublimation; a chemical change because a gas appears升华；化学变化，因为出现了气体
Evaporation; a physical change汽化；物理变化
why: Correct: COX2​(s)​COX2​(g), same substance, so physical.正确：COX2​(s)​COX2​(g)，同种物质，所以是物理变化。
Melting would leave a liquid — there is no puddle.熔化会留下液体——但没有液体。
Right name, but thinks any new gas means chemical; the gas is still COX2​.名称对了，但以为出现气体就是化学变化；气体仍是 COX2​。
Evaporation starts from a liquid; dry ice is a solid.汽化从液体开始；干冰是固体。
diag.goal: Name the change from evidence and classify it as physical.根据证据说出相变名称，并判断为物理变化。
diag.idea: No puddle → no liquid step; same formula → physical.没有液体 → 没有液态这一步；化学式不变 → 物理变化。

diag.q: Water is on the flat part of its heating curve at 0 °C. What is present?水处于加热曲线 0 °C 的水平段上。此时存在什么？
c: Only ice只有冰
Only liquid water只有液态水
Ice and liquid water冰和液态水
Liquid water and water vapour液态水和水蒸气
why: Thinks melting has not started yet — on the plateau it is underway.以为还没开始熔化——在平台上熔化正在进行。
Thinks melting is instant — the ice takes the whole plateau to finish melting.以为熔化瞬间完成——冰要用整个平台的时间才化完。
Correct: during melting both solid and liquid are present.正确：熔化时固体和液体同时存在。
Mixed up the two plateaus: liquid + gas is at 100 °C.把两个平台搞混了：液＋气是在 100 °C。
diag.goal: Identify the phases on the melting plateau.识别熔化平台上的相。
diag.idea: Flat at 0 °C = melting = solid + liquid.0 °C 水平＝熔化＝固＋液。

diag.q: While water boils at 100 °C, energy is still being added. Where does that energy go?水在 100 °C 沸腾时，能量仍在不断加入。这些能量去哪了？
c: It speeds up the particles, so the temperature slowly keeps rising.让粒子加速，所以温度还在慢慢上升。
It is lost to the room; nothing happens to the water.散失到房间里；对水没有任何作用。
It breaks water molecules into hydrogen and oxygen gas.把水分子分解成氢气和氧气。
It separates particles from the liquid into the gas phase, so the temperature stays at 100 °C.把粒子从液体中分开、进入气相，所以温度保持 100 °C。
why: Believes added heat always raises temperature; on a plateau it does not.以为加热一定升温；平台上不会。
Does not see that the energy is doing work on the water — the liquid is turning to gas.没意识到能量正作用在水上——液体正在变成气体。
Confuses a physical change with a chemical one: boiling keeps HX2​O as HX2​O.把物理变化和化学变化混淆：沸腾后 HX2​O 仍是 HX2​O。
Correct: energy goes into separating particles, not into raising their speed.正确：能量用于分开粒子，而不是提高速度。
diag.goal: Explain the boiling plateau and rule out the chemical-change idea.解释沸腾平台，并排除「化学变化」的想法。
diag.idea: Follow the energy into the phase change.追踪能量流向相变。

diag.q: Which describes vibrational motion?哪一项描述的是振动？
c: Atoms stretch and bend; the molecule stays in place.原子伸缩、弯曲；分子位置不变。
The whole molecule moves from place to place.整个分子从一处移到另一处。
The molecule spins; bond lengths and angles stay the same.分子转动；键长、键角不变。
The molecule breaks apart into separate atoms.分子断开成单个原子。
why: Correct: bonds change, position does not.正确：键改变，位置不变。
That is translational — confuses shaking with travelling.那是平动——把抖动和移动混淆了。
That is rotational — confuses spinning with shaking.那是转动——把旋转和抖动混淆了。
Breaking bonds would be a chemical change; vibration only stretches and bends bonds.断键是化学变化；振动只是让键伸缩、弯曲。
diag.goal: Distinguish vibrational from the other two motions.把振动和另外两种运动区分开。
diag.idea: Bonds change + stays in place.键改变＋位置不变。

diag.q: According to the class graph, what lets molecules break out of the solid during melting?根据课堂上的图，熔化时是什么让分子挣脱固体？
c: Their rotational energy drops to zero.转动能降到零。
Their translational energy reaches a critical value.平动能达到临界值。
The bonds inside each water molecule break.每个水分子内部的键断开。
The temperature rises above 0 °C first.温度先升到 0 °C 以上。
why: Energy is being added, not removed; no type of kinetic energy drops to zero.能量是在加入而不是减少；没有哪种动能会降到零。
Correct: enough translational energy lets particles move away from their neighbours.正确：平动能足够大时，粒子才能离开周围粒子。
Confuses melting (physical) with breaking molecules apart (chemical).把熔化（物理变化）和分子分解（化学变化）混淆。
Melting happens AT 0 °C on a flat segment; the temperature does not rise until all the ice has melted.熔化发生在 0 °C 的水平段上；冰全部熔化前温度不会上升。
diag.goal: Connect melting to the critical value of translational energy.把熔化和平动能的临界值联系起来。
diag.idea: Breaking out of a phase needs movement from place to place.挣脱一个相需要「从一处移到另一处」的运动。
